notes_for_editor: Only the Tennessee list row supports the tower itself; the base article covers the base, not a lookout. Two Tennessee web searches found no tower history, and no source ties a fire tower to the base. The list places the tower in Franklin County and the base spans Coffee and Franklin, but nothing shows where the tower stood relative to the base. The story is short on purpose, below the 120-word target, rather than padded. Worth checking the Tennessee Division of Forestry or base public affairs before publishing.
